newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Bass completes merger of Czech brewers.
newsitem.headline: Bass completes merger of Czech brewers.

text.p: Bass Plc said on Tuesday it had completed a merger of its Prague Breweries a.s. unit, and two regional brewers creating the third largest Czech brewer with a 14 percent market share.

"Companies Ostravar a.s. and Pivovary Vratislavice nad Nisou were wound up without liquiditaion...the legal entity which has come into existence through the merger will be named after its largest unit - Prague Breweries," a statement from Bass said.
